author: Lebateleur7
quote:
An overpriced simp simulator disguised as GTA.Very expensive woke **** with a storyline that feels more like a cheap soap opera than a Grand Theft Auto game. Cringeworthy dialogue, forgettable characters, forced drama and a protagonist who feels like a glorified simp. Add the pathetic 30 FPS cap, constant frame drops and clunky gameplay, and you have one of the most overhyped disappointments in gaming history.

Rockstar spent over a decade making a soap opera with cars. What a joke.
